notes: Batch check: none of the 15 items is a park or playground Friends group, so the stewardship office fallback was not needed. The batch mixes a caving grotto, Cultural Fund arts and culture groups, Mummers, and a rowing club. Verdicts: 14 publish (of which 4 are unknown with minimal records and no sources: Al-Bustan, COSACOSA, East Passyunk, GHASP; CAGE is dormant; AMC 20s and 30s is probably_active with no last_sign_of_life date, which conflicts with the tier 1 rule and is flagged in its notes), 1 out_of_area (Seven Valleys Grotto). Several batch website values were aggregators or wrong: the Cultural Fund calendar and grantee directory, the Love Your Park page for BLJ and Centennial, the Meetup find page for AMC and GHASP, the Mummers lineup for Golden Slipper, and nprdpinc.org (a New York parade group) for APM. Each was replaced with the group's own site where one was reachable. Searches: all 3 used (APM, BLJ, CAGE), so no searches were left for GHASP, COSACOSA, East Passyunk, Al-Bustan or the Golden Slipper club. Fetches: 27 of 60. No contact was made with any group, and nothing was submitted or logged in.
